implementation_review: Linux AF_UNIX address spelling changes only: rpc opens the existing STATE directory with O_RDONLY|O_DIRECTORY|O_NOFOLLOW|O_CLOEXEC, connects /proc/self/fd/<fd>/control.sock and closes the directory descriptor in finally.
The connected endpoint remains the existing filesystem control socket. No second listener, authority endpoint, native command path, permission grant, or execution-guard bypass is introduced.
Directory lifetime is held during connect; the connected socket remains valid after that directory descriptor closes. The finally block also closes it if connect fails.
Existing operation encoding, socket timeout, newline framing, response byte limit and server error handling are unchanged.

The long-path regression independently binds a real AF_UNIX server via a restored temporary cwd, asserts the absolute path is over 108 bytes, verifies stopped status, observes the actual status request and response, joins the responder, and verifies stopped status after unlink.
The test does not launch Hoon, a supervisor, or fake ships. Other lifecycle tests remain supporting host/mock evidence.
